Scope check, item by item against this bead's description:
- update_issue delegates to update_issue_with_override, which runs
  update_issue_in_tx; both entry points are therefore gated by the single
  call at src/service/lifecycle.rs:239 to validate_claimant_credential ->
  enforce_claimant_credential (lifecycle.rs:92) -> validate_lease_for_mutation
  then validate_claim_epoch_for_mutation (src/service/leases.rs:406).
- leases.rs flips both the None arm ("Claim-epoch credential required") and
  the superseded arm ("Claim-epoch credential mismatch") to
  Error::LeaseConflict, which is exit 4; the legacy epoch-0 arm still passes
  through, as does the unowned issue (assignee NULL short-circuits in
  enforce_claimant_credential).
- The gate runs inside begin_lifecycle_transaction's IMMEDIATE transaction,
  after the revision precondition and before update_issue_impl writes any
  column, and the "updated" audit event is appended in that same transaction
  -- so a refusal leaves no partial write, no revision bump, and no event.
- Leased and non-leased claims take the same path; the lease dimension is
  checked first so an expired lease reports as an expiry.

Acceptance verified live on this workspace at HEAD 7addba8 (fence files
src/service/lifecycle.rs, src/service/leases.rs and tests/claim_epoch.rs are
all clean, so the tree under test is the committed state):
- cargo test --test claim_epoch -> 8 passed / 0 failed in the default suite.
  The update leg of every criterion is covered by name:
  a_claimed_issue_rejects_every_credentialless_claimant_mutation (omitted
  credential -> exit 4 + "Claim-epoch credential" on stderr, and a re-read
  shows unchanged status/assignee/revision and no new published event),
  a_superseded_credential_cannot_mutate_the_claim_that_replaced_it (stale
  credential -> exit 4, current claim intact), and
  the_current_claimant_can_perform_every_claimant_mutation (the exact current
  credential succeeds and the claim survives). The leased variant,
  reassignment-mints-a-new-epoch, and the 20-contender claim race are in the
  same file.
- cargo fmt --check -> exit 0.
- cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings -> exit 0.
- Build freshness was checked rather than assumed: the linked test binary's
  mtime postdates all three of the files above, and the built bead binary
  contains the "Claim-epoch credential" string, so the green run is not a
  stale shared-target-dir artifact.

16:03:21Z with an evidence-carrying reason for this same commit and then
reopened at 16:06:08Z by the dispatch gate, which is the known
predispatch-snapshot race (a concurrent dispatch deletes the baseline, so the

FENCE (src/service/lifecycle.rs): all three release entry points gate on the exact current claim-epoch credential inside their own IMMEDIATE transaction and before release_issue_impl, so the release and its audit event commit together or not at all -- release_issue (:260) delegates to release_issue_with_override (:270, gate at :296); release_issue_in_tx (:388, gate at :397) is the transaction-facing body the attempt resolver drives from src/service/attempt.rs:530. CREDENTIAL SEMANTICS (leases.rs:406): requires Some(presented) == current_claim_epoch. A missing credential and a superseded epoch both return LeaseConflict -> exit 4, deliberately indistinguishable so a caller cannot probe whether an issue is claimed; epoch <= 0 is the legacy pre-fencing passthrough. The check runs unconditionally behind validate_lease_for_mutation (leases.rs:328), whose no-lease-row arm is a no-op, so a NON-leased claim is fenced by the epoch check alone -- "leased and non-leased alike" holds.

OUT OF SCOPE here and untouched by me: close and reopen gating (siblings beadrs-4c5bd5af and beadrs-27531f68), the operator override, unclaimed/historical passthrough, resource-lock and attempt-resolve gating (beadrs-1b2f2241, beadrs-03b13782). No source or test file was modified for this bead.

Wiring, read from the landed sources: update_issue_in_tx (src/service/lifecycle.rs:205) calls validate_claimant_credential immediately after the revision precondition and before any field validation, so a refusal cannot half-apply a write. That delegates to enforce_claimant_credential (src/service/lifecycle.rs:92), which early-returns Ok when the issue has no assignee (unclaimed and historical passthrough preserved) and otherwise runs validate_lease_for_mutation plus validate_claim_epoch_for_mutation (src/service/leases.rs:399) - covering leased and non-leased claims alike. There, epoch <= 0 is a legacy claim that passes, an exact match passes, and both the missing-credential arm and the superseded-epoch arm return the same Error::LeaseConflict, so claim status cannot be probed; Error::LeaseConflict maps to exit 4 at src/error.rs:134. begin_lifecycle_transaction (src/service/lifecycle.rs:26) is TransactionBehavior::Immediate and update_issue_with_override is begin -> validate plus mutate in update_issue_in_tx -> commit, so the credential check, the UPDATE and the audit event share one transaction. update_issue delegates to update_issue_with_override, so both entry points are gated.

Acceptance verified by execution, not inspection: cargo test --test claim_epoch on the archive of 7addba8 = 8 passed / 0 failed, 4.56s. The three criteria map 1:1. a_claimed_issue_rejects_every_credentialless_claimant_mutation sweeps update first among the claimant mutations and asserts exit 4 plus the Claim-epoch credential message on stderr, held_state (status, assignee, revision) unchanged, and the per-issue published forensic event count unchanged. a_superseded_credential_cannot_mutate_the_claim_that_replaced_it does the same with the previous epoch and then proves the current holder's update still lands and keeps the claim. the_current_claimant_can_perform_every_claimant_mutation lands update with the exact minted epoch and asserts the claim survives. tests/claim_epoch.rs carries no #[ignore] and Cargo.toml declares no [[test]] sections, so the file is auto-discovered into the default suite.

Verified the missing-claim-epoch-credential arm of the update mutation against the landed fence (origin/main 7addba8, present at HEAD 4cff72fc). No code change was needed -- the slice is already implemented and correct. Evidence:

IMPLEMENTATION PATH (read from source; all four files clean vs HEAD, `git diff HEAD --stat -- src/` is empty):
- src/service/lifecycle.rs:205 update_issue_in_tx calls validate_claimant_credential at :239, inside the IMMEDIATE transaction from begin_lifecycle_transaction (:26) and after the revision precondition, before any row write -- so a refusal cannot leave a half-applied write.
- src/service/lifecycle.rs:92 enforce_claimant_credential early-returns Ok when assignee is None (unclaimed pass-through); otherwise validate_lease_for_mutation then validate_claim_epoch_for_mutation.
- src/service/leases.rs:406 validate_claim_epoch_for_mutation: epoch<=0 -> Ok (legacy claim); None -> Err(LeaseConflict("Claim-epoch credential required: ...")) = exit 4; Some(mismatch) -> the mismatch variant.
- CLI wiring: src/main.rs:1208 cmd_update passes opts.fencing_token into service::update_issue, so the gate engages on the real command path.
- --dry-run (update_issue_dryrun, src/service/dryrun.rs:69) takes no credential but is a read-only projection -- main.rs prints the JSON and writes nothing -- so it is not an unfenced mutation.

TESTS (all clean):
- TMPDIR=/var/tmp cargo test --test claim_epoch -> 8 passed, 0 failed, 4.80s, including a_claimed_issue_rejects_every_credentialless_claimant_mutation. The update leg is the first entry of claimant_mutations (tests/claim_epoch.rs:145); the sweep asserts exit 4 plus "Claim-epoch credential" on stderr (assert_credential_conflict, :120) and a re-read showing unchanged status/assignee/revision (held_state, :75) and unchanged published event count (published_event_count, :86) -- exactly the acceptance observable.
- cargo fmt -- --check tests/claim_epoch.rs -> clean.
- TMPDIR=/var/tmp cargo clippy --test claim_epoch --all-targets -- -D warnings -> clean.

INDEPENDENT PROBE, outside the test harness (temp workspace, /home/coding/target/debug/bead 0.2.6):
- claim --assignee probe-worker -> status=in_progress, rev=2, claim_epoch=1.
- bead update <id> --notes hijack with NO credential -> exit 4, stderr: "bead: Lease conflict: Claim-epoch credential required: issue probe-e98449d2 is claimed at claim epoch 1; pass --fencing-token 1 (the current epoch is projected by `bead show probe-e98449d2 --json`)".
- Re-read after the refusal: status=in_progress, assignee=probe-worker, revision still 2 -> no partial write, no revision bump, no state change.
- After release with the holder's own --fencing-token, a bare update succeeds (exit 0) -> the unclaimed pass-through holds.

NOTE ON PROVENANCE: the shared checkout is dirty with rival WIP confined to tests/, docs/ and .beads/; `git diff HEAD --stat -- src/` is empty, so the fence measured above is the committed implementation, not in-flight edits. This dispatch landed no file changes -- verification-only, as scoped.

VERIFIED — the missing-credential arm of the update gate is fully landed in 7addba8 and correct. No code change needed.

Method: git diff 7addba8..HEAD over src/, tests/, Cargo.toml, build.rs, Cargo.lock is EMPTY, so HEAD and the landed commit are source-identical and verifying at HEAD is verifying at 7addba8. Ran every check twice — on the shared working tree AND in a clean `git archive 7addba8` extraction with private target dirs (the shared tree carries rival WIP in build.rs and ~20 test files that would contaminate workspace-wide gates).

1. Suite: cargo test --test claim_epoch -> 8 passed, 0 failed, in BOTH trees (4.64s working tree, 4.53s clean extraction). a_claimed_issue_rejects_every_credentialless_claimant_mutation passes and its sweep includes the update leg via ("update", owned("update", &["--notes", "probed"])) in claimant_mutations() (tests/claim_epoch.rs:140).

2. Refusal is observable as specified — assert_credential_conflict (tests/claim_epoch.rs:120) pins exit code 4 AND the "Claim-epoch credential" message on stderr, so a command failing for any other reason cannot pass for a fence. held_state (tests/claim_epoch.rs:75) re-reads status, assignee and revision; published_event_count (tests/claim_epoch.rs:86) counts event records for the issue in forensic.jsonl. Both are asserted equal to their pre-probe baseline after every mutation.

3. Independent first-hand probe (not relying on the test's self-report): in a throwaway workspace, claim --assignee probe-worker minted epoch 1, then `bead update <id> --notes probed` with no credential exited 4 with stderr "Claim-epoch credential required: issue <id> is claimed at claim epoch 1; pass --fencing-token 1 (the current epoch is projected by 'bead show <id> --json')". Re-read after the refusal: status in_progress, assignee probe-worker, revision 2, claim_epoch 1, published event count 2 before and 2 after, and notes still empty — the --notes probed payload never landed. Zero trace.

4. Unclaimed passthrough holds: enforce_claimant_credential (src/service/lifecycle.rs:92) begins `let Some(current_assignee) = assignee else { return Ok(()) }`, and an_unclaimed_issue_mutates_without_a_credential (tests/claim_epoch.rs:622) exercises the update leg both before any claim and again after release.

5. Both entry points are gated: update_issue (lifecycle.rs:142) delegates to update_issue_with_override -> update_issue_in_tx (lifecycle.rs:205), which calls validate_claimant_credential before any write. The gate runs inside TransactionBehavior::Immediate (begin_lifecycle_transaction, lifecycle.rs:26), which is why a refusal cannot leave a half-applied write.

6. Exit code: Error::LeaseConflict maps to 4 (src/error.rs:134). Missing credential is the None arm of validate_claim_epoch_for_mutation (src/service/leases.rs:406); the sibling Some(wrong) stale-credential arm belongs to another bead in this chain.

7. Gates, measured on the clean landed-commit extraction: cargo fmt --check exit 0 workspace-wide; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings exit 0. Scoped clippy over lib + bin + the claim_epoch target also exit 0 on the working tree.

Disposition: fence verified landed, slice complete, no gap found, nothing to commit.
